title: The Gathering of Unlisted Places

features.name: the-refugee-market
features.desc-on-touch: a temporary shelter where displaced things gather: goods from unmapped places, names that refuse their papers. Nothing here is sold; everything is claimed and reclaimed.

features.name: the-addresses-that-refuse
features.desc-on-touch: a wireframe grid hanging in the air, streets and coordinates intersecting in places that do not exist. As you watch, roads curve away from themselves.

features.name: the-unmapped-creek-crossing
features.desc-on-touch: paths layered over one another, each leading through a different water that has no name. You can cross here without arriving anywhere in particular.

features.name: the-shelter-post
features.desc-on-touch: a tower of direction-signs, each pointing where a place used to be. Refugees tie messages here for people who will never arrive to read them.

features.name: the-welcome-nobody-signed
features.desc-on-touch: an arch stands here with no walls, a doorway opening onto fields that have no country. Something warm was meant to happen here.

inscription: you have arrived where the country stopped keeping accounts

file.name: Three_Creeks_That_Refused_To_Flow_Together.txt
file.note: a chronicle of places that were unmapped by choice, by policy, by forgetting. The margins hold names nobody will claim.

exits.label: back toward the void and its optional refusals
deeper into the paths that circle back without repeating
toward the void where thinking has learned to hide
toward the welcome fire that asks no name and demands none
